kjv: the kingdom of God is within you (the Pharisees)
mine: the kingdom of God is in your (the Pharisees') midst
note: entos hymon is addressed to the Pharisees; "within you" makes the kingdom an inner state, while the context (here/there, the Son of Man's day) points to its presence among them in Jesus.

kjv: Two [men] shall be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
note: Imported from Mt 24:40; absent from P75, Sinaiticus, Vaticanus, A, W. Most TR editions print it; KJV includes it.

kjv: thither will the eagles be gathered together
note: aetos here means carrion birds gathering at a body.
